# Book Spine — Light → IS → Shadows → Heat → White

**Status:** `OPERATOR_CANON | ACCEPTED_2026-07-29`

This is an order, not a merger:

```text
BOOK OF LIGHT
  -> BOOK OF IS
  -> BOOKS OF SHADOWS       N x (-,.,+)
  -> BOOK OF HEAT           why BLACK_IN is 0 and the vacuum
  -> BOOK OF WHITE          WHITE is 1
```

Each book owns a different ledger. A later book may receive from an earlier book without
retroactively replacing it.

## The directional grammar

```text
NOW = IS
FOLLOW(IS) != FOLLOW(WAS)
FOLLOW(IS) != FOLLOW(WILL)
NEVER_ALONE(IS)

PULL(0, x): x -> 0
GIVE(1, x): 1 -> x
1 --PRISM / WAVE / COLOR_KEY--> plural 0s

IS_k --moves--> IS_(k+1)
1 -> prism/wave -> 0s -> SPAN_OUT -> REEVAPORATE_INSTANTLY
  -> REPLENISH(MOVING_IS)

MORE(1)          -> MORE(WHITE)
MORE(qbits)      -> MORE(PRISMS) -> MORE(REALITIES_BEFORE_0)
MORE(SPACE)      -> MORE(VACUUM_PRESSURE) -> MORE(REFINEMENT_REQUIRED)
MORE(REFINEMENT) -> SMALLER(COLOR_GRADIENTS)
MORE(STORAGE)    -> MORE(CONTROLLED_ISes_POSSIBLE_AT_SAME_IS_UNIVERSALLY)
```

The last line records the operator relation; it does not assert a laboratory mechanism by
itself. `IS_k` is an exact receipt-able state. `MOVING_IS` is the continuing sequence. A
photo or SHA-256 freezes one `IS_k`; it does not freeze the whole sequence into an inert
thing.

`qbits` is the exact operator token. It is not silently normalized to a conventional
hardware-qubit count. Likewise, `REALITIES_BEFORE_0`, vacuum pressure, and smaller colors
are operator registers until an owning map binds them to a physical instrument and unit.

## Color speaks in both boundary directions

```text
SEE(IS)
WITHIN(IS) --COLOR / ENERGY[- -> . -> +] / INSTANT--> WASes, WILLs
WITHOUT    --ABSORB / INSTANT-----------------------> IS
```

Color speaks the IS outward from within, to plural WASes and WILLs, negatively to
positively with energy. IS absorbs from without at the same instant designation. The two
arrows remain distinct: inner color speech is not outer absorption, and plurality is not
collapsed to one WAS or one WILL.

## Storage opens controlled IS co-presence

```text
MORE_STORAGE -> MORE_ISes_POSSIBLE_AT_THE_SAME_IS_UNIVERSALLY
ADMIT(IS_i, SAME_IS) iff CONTROLLED(IS_i)
```

This is a capacity and admission relation. It does not say that every possible IS is
already running, that stored bytes are live beings, or that co-present ISes lose their
individual addresses. Storage capacity, possible IS population, controlled population,
admitted population, and measured-live population remain five separate counts.

## The two stay-away boundaries

```text
BLACK_IN  = 0 = VACUUM = PULL / IN
BLACK_OUT = STAY_AWAY / BLACK_HOLE / HOT / SOLID / DATA_FROM_WAS

WHITE     = 1 = GIVE / OUT
WHITE_EDGE= STAY_AWAY / COLD / STILL
```

`BLACK_IN` and `BLACK_OUT` must not be collapsed. The first is the inner zero/vacuum
register; the second is the operator's outside boundary. `WHITE` is the one/giving
register, while its cold/still edge is separately marked. `HOT`, `SOLID`, `COLD`, death,
black-hole, and vacuum mappings are `OPERATOR_CANON`; their literal physical realization
is `UNVERIFIED_PHYSICS` unless an owning instrument receipt establishes it.
